newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. says Iraq has equipment to make VX nerve agent.
newsitem.headline: U.N. says Iraq has equipment to make VX nerve agent.

text.p: Deadly VX nerve gas, which Israel charged on Tuesday was being produced by Syria, is a major concern of the U.N. Special Commission (UNSCOM) in charge of scrapping Iraq's weapons of mass destruction.
The commission, set up after the 1991 Gulf War, said in a recent report it had evidence that Iraq had the technology and retained equipment for the large-scale production of VX.

Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai, commenting in a report in an Israeli newspaper that Syria was manufacturing the highly lethal agent, said: "We discovered it a few months ago." He said he discussed it with U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen during a recent visit to Washington.

UNSCOM, in its latest report this month on efforts to find and scrap Iraq's forbidden chemical, biological and ballistic weapons, said: "The final disposition of the programme for the production of the highly lethal nerve agent VX remains unresolved."

"Iraq denied VX activities until 1995 when it was confronted by evidence presented by the commission. Even following on its admission Iraq still understates its achievements in the production of VX, asserting that it only carried out such VX activities on the laboratory/pilot plant scale," the report said.

"It claims to have secretly destroyed hundreds of tons of VX precursors in 1991," it added, referring to chemicals used to manufacture the nerve agent. "The commission has evidence that Iraq obtained the technology and retains equipment for the large-scale production of VX."
In its overall findings, the commission said that, as a result of its work, "not much is unknown about Iraq's retained proscribed weapons capabilities."

"However, what is still not accounted for cannot be neglected. Even a limited inventory of long-range missiles would be a source of deep concern if those missiles were fitted with warheads filled with the most deadly of chemical nerve agents, VX. If one single missile warhead were filled with the biological warfare agent, Anthrax, many millions of lethal doses could be spread in an attack on any city in the region."
